item.title: Các học liệu GIS hay và miễn phí 2025
item.description:
Các học liệu GIS hay và miễn phí 2025 (ngôn ngữ tiếng Anh) sưu tầm bởi Thầy Tùng HANU

https://courses.spatialthoughts.com/index.html
Ujaval Gandhi course on QGIS

https://sustainability-gis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html
Spatial data science for sustainable development (Aalto Finland)

https://handsondataviz.org/
Hands-On Data Visualization, Interactive Storytelling from Spreadsheets to Code

https://geobgu.xyz/web-mapping2/
Introduction to Web Mapping, Michael Dorman

https://darribas.org/gds_course
A course on Geographic Data Science - Dani Arribas-Bel, University of Liverpool

https://earth-env-data-science.github.io/intro.html
An Introduction to Earth and Environmental Data Science

https://geographicdata.science/book/intro
Geographic Data Science with Python

https://courses.gisopencourseware.org/course/index.php
GIS ứng dụng OCW IHE Delft

https://geocompr.robinlovelace.net/
Geocomputation with R
